Choosatron Stories

Stories for the Choosatron

53 interactive stories for the Choosatron, the choose-your-own-adventure machine that prints as you play. Every one is free.

How to put a story on your Choosatron
  1. From your Choosatron: open its web interface and go to the Catalog tab. It shows this same list and installs a story in one step.
  2. From this page: download the story, then open your Choosatron's Stories tab and drop the file on Drop a story file here. This works even when your Choosatron has no internet connection.

This site can't install stories by itself: a web page here isn't allowed to reach a device on your home network.
